oneLiner: The most accurate free answers to "how long will my portable power station run this?" and "what size power station do I need?", with calculators, per-appliance pages and verified specs for popular models.
audience: Campers, van-lifers and RV owners sizing a battery for a trip
Homeowners preparing for power outages (fridge, sump pump, CPAP, internet)
People about to buy a power station who want to know which capacity they need
US first (120 V, watts and watt-hours). Mention 230 V where it changes the answer.
competitors: Search results are crowded with thin AI-built calculators and affiliate review posts. Search for these by name: shopsavvy's runtime tool, backuppowerhub, solarbackuplab, batteryskills, portablepowerstationreview. Most offer one calculator with fixed assumptions, unsourced wattage numbers and no per-appliance or per-model depth. Beat them on depth, sourced numbers and honest caveats.
monetization: High buyer intent: the owner may add affiliate links or ads after launch. Never add them yourself. Keep model pages neutral and factual.
doneText:
# DONE: v5 of powerstationruntime.netlify.app (the 10 best next pages from v4)

Finished 2026-10-06 in 1 run (budget 30). Every unit passed `npm test` and a reviewer subagent before being pushed to `main`. Origin `main` had been force-rewritten by the owner; the local copy was reset to it at the start of the run.

## What was built (page → target keyword)
| Page | Target keyword |
|---|---|
| `/gas-furnace/` | power station for a gas furnace blower |
| `/air-fryer/` | can a power station run an air fryer |
| `/rice-cooker/` | power station for a rice cooker |
| `/induction-cooktop/` | can a power station run an induction cooktop |
| `/projector/` | power station for a projector / outdoor movie |
| `/blender/` | power station for a blender |

55 URLs in the sitemap (v1 to v4 pages: see `.ai/done-v1.md` to `.ai/done-v4.md`). No new lib code, so no new unit tests (43 unit tests still pass).

## Decisions / skipped
- `/garage-door-opener/` skipped: Chamberlain says its amp/watt ratings are measured idle with lights off and gives no load figure.
- `/portable-ice-maker/` skipped: Frigidaire pages gave no watts; NewAir lists 200 W for one variant but 2.7 A for a sibling, GE Opal gives amps only, Euhomy's 170 W only came from retailers.
- `/phone-charges/` still skipped (K-0007: mAh without volts).
- C800 Plus and Jackery 300 Plus model pages still skipped (surge / cycle-life specs ambiguous).
- Instant Pot Vortex Plus 4 qt watts were not returned by search, so the air fryer page uses the Vortex Mini 4 qt (1,500 W).
- Gas furnace figures are U.S. DOE material (180 W total, 382 W, about 500 to 650 W blower), not one maker's furnace. The page says to use a licensed electrician for hard-wired furnaces.
- Vitamix 5200 (about 1,380 W) and the Optoma/Epson projector ratings include a derived or secondary figure; the pages label them.

## Test results
`npm test`: check OK (55 pages), 43 unit tests pass, 235 browser tests pass (1 skipped).

## Unsure of
- All values come from WebSearch snippets of makers' and DOE pages (WebFetch blocked); spot-check the Nuwave settings (600/900/1,300 and 900/1,500/1,800 W), Aroma 350 W, Instant Pot Zest 450 W, Zojirushi NS-ZCC10 680 W, Ninja AF101 1,550 W and Optoma HD28HDR 295/215 W.
- No `site/data/*.json` entries back these new pages' figures; sources are linked on each page.
- Reviewers could not open the cited pages; links came from search results.

## Owner's launch checklist
1. Check that the Netlify site serves https://powerstationruntime.netlify.app/.
2. Add that address to Google Search Console as a URL-prefix property (verification tag is on the home page).
3. Submit `/sitemap.xml` (55 URLs).
4. Buy powerstationruntime.com when there's budget, then move with 301 redirects.

## 10 best next pages (ranked by judgement of search demand and weakness of results; not checked in Semrush)
1. `/dishwasher/`: can a power station run a dishwasher (ENERGY STAR / maker watts).
2. `/toaster-oven/`: power station for a toaster oven (maker watts).
3. `/slow-cooker/`: power station for a slow cooker / Crock-Pot (maker watts).
4. `/mini-fridge/`: power station for a mini fridge / dorm fridge (ENERGY STAR kWh/yr).
5. `/mini-split/`: power station for a ductless mini split (maker watts, inverter caveat).
6. `/pellet-stove/`: power station for a pellet stove (maker watts).
7. `/3d-printer/`: power station for a 3D printer (maker watts).
8. `/portable-ice-maker/`: once a maker gives one consistent watts figure.
9. `/garage-door-opener/`: once a maker gives a load figure.
10. `/phone-charges/` and the C800 Plus / Jackery 300 Plus model pages, once specs are unambiguous.
